news_items.headline: Corning lands $500 million Nvidia deal; stock surges to intraday high
news_items.summary: Corning signed a $500M deal with Nvidia to supply optical connectivity components for AI data center build-out, part of a multi-year US manufacturing partnership.

news_items.headline: Corning Stock (GLW) Rallied 12% on Wednesday on NVIDIA partnership
news_items.summary: GLW jumped 12% intraday after announcing three new US factories (Texas and North Carolina) to grow optical connectivity capacity 10x and fiber capacity 50% to meet AI data center demand.

news_items.headline: GLW Stock Rallies As AI And Solar Growth Targets Jump
news_items.summary: Corning extended Springboard growth plan through 2030: high-confidence target of $35B annualized sales (internal goal $40B), with $27B by 2028 (internal $30B) and $20B by end of 2026.

news_items.headline: Oppenheimer raises GLW price target to $210 from $120, maintains Outperform
news_items.summary: Oppenheimer analyst Martin Yang raised price target from $120 to $210 (75% increase) while maintaining Outperform rating following the NVIDIA partnership and Springboard extension.

news_items.headline: Why Corning Stock Plummeted This Week
news_items.summary: Earlier in the week (pre-NVIDIA news) GLW had fallen sharply per Motley Fool coverage; this preceded the multi-day rally triggered by the Nvidia announcement and growth plan extension.

news_items.headline: Corning Inc Stock (GLW) Moved Up 3.20% on May 5
news_items.summary: GLW gained 3.20% on May 5 in lead-up to the NVIDIA partnership announcement, building on a 3.07% open-up on May 4.

news_items.headline: Why Corning Stock Skyrocketed Today
news_items.summary: Motley Fool attributed the May 6 surge to the NVIDIA partnership, three new US factories announcement, and extended Springboard growth targets.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Oppenheimer raised PT from $120 to $210 (Outperform) on 2026-05-07. Citi raised PT to $175, Susquehanna moved to $180 (Positive), UBS raised to $179. Consensus 11 Buy / 2 Hold / 1 Sell.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 already reported: beat on EPS and revenue with 18% core sales growth and 30% core EPS growth, powered by Gen AI optical demand and ~80% YoY solar growth. Street expects continued AI data center momentum into Q2.
